Name: Gabriel
Summary: Gabriel is the angel who explains Daniel's visions and who announces the births of John the Baptist and of Jesus. Daniel calls him 'the man Gabriel'; Luke calls him the angel who stands in the presence of God. Nothing beyond these biblical appearances is asserted here.
RelatedPeople: Daniel; Zechariah, Father of John the Baptist; Mary, Mother of Jesus
LifeLesson: God's messages come to ordinary people in ordinary places.
